name: Park Jae-hyun
bio:
Park Jae-hyun's career began in the bustling advertising world of Seoul, where he honed his skills in brand building and consumer engagement. While successful, he yearned for something more visceral and challenging, leading him to motorsport. He saw parallels between crafting a compelling brand narrative and building a racing team's image. Park believes in a data-driven approach, meticulously analyzing market trends and fan engagement metrics to tailor effective marketing campaigns.

At Trident, Park is known for his relentless pursuit of perfection and his unwavering focus on results. He's not afraid to push boundaries and challenge conventional marketing strategies, always seeking innovative ways to connect with fans and sponsors. While some may find his demanding nature challenging, his dedication to excellence is undeniable. His creative campaigns have significantly boosted Trident's visibility and brand recognition in recent seasons.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly parted, short hair with a slight wave
physical.description: A man of medium build, Park's sharp features and intense gaze convey his focused demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas, regardless of the situation.
Insists on trying local delicacies when traveling for races, rating them meticulously.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rapidly when deep in thought, driving some colleagues to distraction.
